tools.name: openweather_geocode

Drop-in for OpenWeather /geo/1.0/direct: q = "City", "City,CC" or "City,State,CC" -> [{name, lat, lon, country, state}]. 230k+ places (GeoNames, CC BY 4.0). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: openweather_forecast_5day · Private data: edgar_company_submissions · Public sink: openweather_current_weather, openweather_forecast_5day, openweather_geocode, openweather_reverse_geocode, mapbox_geocode_forward, mapbox_geocode_reverse, edgar_company_submissions, edgar_company_facts, edgar_company_concept · Destructive: openweather_current_weather, openweather_forecast_5day, openweather_geocode, openweather_reverse_geocode.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: openweather_forecast_5day · Private data: edgar_company_submissions · Public sink: openweather_current_weather, openweather_forecast_5day, openweather_geocode, openweather_reverse_geocode, mapbox_geocode_forward, mapbox_geocode_reverse, edgar_company_submissions, edgar_company_facts, edgar_company_concept · Destructive: openweather_current_weather, openweather_forecast_5day, openweather_geocode, openweather_reverse_geocode

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
